verdict_rationale: Project (BMP Wind LLC = Mesquite Sky) achieved commercial operations in December 2021 / January 2022. Confirmed by Clearway Energy SEC 10-K (FY2021 and FY2025). Imagery shows pre-construction (June 2020), active construction (June 2021), and fully operational wind farm (July 2026). ERCOT queue entry is an orphaned stale record — never received commercial-operation-approved milestone despite being fully operational for 4+ years.

ercot_queue_status.assessment: ORPHANED/STALE RECORD — Project physically operational since January 2022 per Clearway Energy SEC filings, but ERCOT never issued commercial-operation-approved milestone. Queue entry appears administratively stalled. The 2026-12-31 COD is a queue artifact, not a real construction target.
